assets.name: 剧情钉子户
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one original full-body 3D cartoon character portrait for 游格, wardrobe V2 sample.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing V1 character, not a loose style reference.
Primary request: redesign ONLY clothing and footwear, retaining this exact individual. This is a costume change for the same character, not a new person.
Invariants: same facial identity and facial proportions, same eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, gender presentation, hairstyle, hair color, and original personality-defining props with their delicate details. Keep the original premium stylized 3D collectible figurine finish, rounded appealing proportions, delicate textile rendering and gentle warm studio illumination. Do not copy a known game or personality-test mascot.
Composition: single person, full body head to toe, all hands, footwear and held props completely visible, centered in a portrait 2:3 canvas with comfortable padding. Approximately the same camera and face direction as the original to allow identity comparison. A slight pose adjustment is allowed only to display the outfit better.
Background: genuinely transparent cutout, including the surrounding negative space, no colored backdrop, no floor, no printed checkerboard, no text or watermark. Preserve original objects rather than replacing them with generic equivalents.
Design objective: a distinct garment silhouette and shoe construction, not a simple hue shift of the original adventure outfit. No green or olive garments in this sample.
Specific locked identity and props: the thoughtful young woman with a short wavy dark-brown bob, absorbed gentle expression, exactly the same glowing brass lantern in her left hand and opened decorated storybook in her right hand. Retain the familiar long flowing copper-red scarf, delicate brass charms, compass charm and small pouch; the book's original green cover may stay green because it is a retained prop.
Replace the olive cape, cream layered tunic, leather corset, trousers and tall brown boots with a cohesive midnight-blue vintage reading dress: a fitted high-waisted bodice, modest small collar, softly tailored straight three-quarter sleeves, and a flowing finely pleated A-line skirt ending above the ankles. Delicate antique-gold stitching only at cuffs and hem, not covered in gears or belts. Midnight blue must form the large continuous clothing silhouette. Keep the long copper-red scarf as a small energetic accent against the blue. A single slim sash can carry the original small charms and pouch without the old leather corset.
Footwear: clearly visible polished black rounded-toe low-heeled Oxford shoes with thin soles and dark navy ankle stockings. These are low shoes, not ankle or knee boots. No cargo pockets, no large adventure cape, no puffy cream blouse, no chunky hiking soles.
Mood: quiet and absorbed in the story, still charming, not severe or elderly.
